scripts.test:web: pnpm.cmd --dir apps/web run lint && pnpm.cmd --dir apps/web run typecheck && pnpm.cmd --dir apps/web run test
scripts.test:ai-service: bash -c 'cd apps/ai-service && python -m pip install --upgrade "pip==26.1.2" && if uname -s | grep -qiE "^(MINGW|MSYS|CYGWIN)"; then python -m pip install --editable ".[test]"; else sha256sum --check pylock.test.toml.sha256 && python -m pip install --requirement pylock.test.toml; fi && python -m ruff check . && python -m ruff format --check . && python -m pyright && python -m pytest'
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
